transcript: Speaker A: भैया ये दवाई देना। [Brother, please give this medicine.] Speaker B: ये तो इंग्लिश में लिखी है पर्ची। आपको समझ आ रही है क्या इसमें क्या लिखा है? [This prescription is written in English. Do you understand what is written in it?] Speaker A: हाँ भैया, समझ आ रही है। [Yes brother, I understand.] Speaker B: अच्छा? तो फिर पढ़ के बताइए क्या-क्या चाहिए। क्योंकि मुझे तो लगता है किसी पढ़े-लिखे को भेजती तो अच्छा होता। [Really? Then read it and tell me what you need. Because I think it would have been better if you had sent someone educated.] Speaker A: Sure, I need Amoxicillin 500 mg, one capsule three times a day after meals for five days. Pantoprazole 40 mg, one tablet daily before breakfast, and Cetirizine 10 mg, one at night for the allergies. Shall I spell them out for you? Speaker B: मैडम आप... आपको तो इंग्लिश बहुत अच्छी आती है। sorry मैंने... [Madam, you... you know English very well. Sorry, I...] Speaker A: कोई बात नहीं भैया। पहले मुझे भी नहीं आती थी। 'English Seekho' ऐप से सीखी। एक्सपर्ट के वीडियोस देखे, हिंदी में समझा के इंग्लिश सिखाते हैं। AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस की। रोज़ 15 मिनट दिया बस। [No problem, brother. Earlier, I didn't know either. I learned from the 'English Seekho' app. Watched expert videos, they teach English by explaining in Hindi. Practiced with AI coach. Just gave 15 minutes daily.] Speaker C: मैडम, ये ऐप का नाम क्या बोला आपने? [Madam, what did you say the name of this app was?] Speaker A: English Seekho ऐप। ट्रायल सिर्फ एक रुपये का है। डाउनलोड करो और शुरू हो जाओ। [English Seekho app. The trial is only for one rupee. Download and get started.] Speaker D: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A pharmacist mocks a young woman, assuming she cannot read an English prescription. She surprises him by reading it fluently and explains she learned English using the 'English Seekho' app. She highlights the app's features and its 1-rupee trial, urging viewers to download it.
